messages.subject: Milkweed fibre
messages.text:
Good day,

 

 I am doing research on the development of sustainable natural fibres for noise reduction in vehicles. The research uses milkweed fibre. We need 2 kilograms of fibre and want to know if you will be able to supply us?

 

 I look forward to you response. 

 

 Kind regards 

 

 Regan Dunne 

 Lecturer 

 BscHons, MTech, PhD
 

 PrTechEng 

 Department of Mechanical and Mechatronics Engineering 

 Tshwane University of Technology,
 Pretoria Campus

 Pretoria, South Africa

messages.subject: REQUEST TO VOLUNTEER AT LASCLAY
messages.text:
Good day Gab / Lasclay 

 I am writing you as PhD candidate in Natural Fibres (Milkweed fibres), here request to volunteer at Lasclay. 
 

 For that it gives Lasclay exposure not only in my country South Africa, but story of my life worldwide. 
 

 Please consider my request and you’re welcome for any further details.
 

 Regard
 Mash. 
 PhD Researcher, Macro-Economics | FinTech

messages.subject: Re: REQUEST TO VOLUNTEER AT LASCLAY
messages.text:
Thank you for reaching out and for your interest in Lasclay.
 

 We’re grateful that our work resonates with your research and your personal story. At this time, we’re not able to welcome volunteers or take on this type of collaboration.
 

 That said, your focus on natural fibres and milkweed is meaningful, and we truly encourage you to keep pursuing this path. It’s a field with a lot of potential, and your work sounds valuable.
 

 Wishing you all the best with your PhD and research.
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Gabriel 
 Co-founder 
 Lasclay
